decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 4024/1(existing), 4024/1 (proposed)Received 28th June 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The proposed roof lights to the front roof slope should be low profile and 'conservation style'.

Condition : 5 - No demolition of construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am and 6pm on Mondays to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with front roof windows to the house
